description: Capture the visible screen and run approved desktop actions through separated macOS, Windows, and Linux Computer Use drivers. macOS uses the native Swift host first, Windows uses Win32/UIA drivers, and Linux prefers a rumiai-owned Xvfb/Openbox virtual desktop before visible desktop utilities. Use context/apps/windows, show_app to bring Vivaldi/Chrome/etc. to the main screen, and select_window before screenshots or actions. When the user asks to operate an app with mouse/keyboard, treat open_url or app launch as setup only; verify the visible UI and continue with type/key/click/scroll. Safe type/key/scroll actions try background mode by default when a trusted non-physical background driver is available; if support, permission, or approval is missing, the tool prompts the user before any foreground fallback. For browser UI navigation, prefer show_app/select_window, key command+l, type the user-requested URL or search text, then key return. The type text is literal input content; do not type the current URL, app name, or window title unless the user explicitly requested that text. For visual clicks, use the zoom ladder: full or selected-window screenshot, crop/zoom the likely region with source=latest when the target is small, then click with normalized_x/normalized_y relative to that attached crop. source=latest crops from the last full/selected-window screenshot; use source=current_crop only when intentionally cropping the current crop again. Take a fresh full/selected-window screenshot before unrelated actions so old zoom coordinates are not reused. Hidden host-window control is disabled; use fallback=foreground only after the user confirms foreground work.

config.name: computer_use
config.summary: macOS(Swift host)、Windows(Win32/UIA)、Linux(Xvfb仮想desktop優先 + visible fallback)を分けたComputer Use。LinuxではホストWaylandの裏ウィンドウを直接叩かず、rumiai所有のX11仮想DISPLAYを使える場合はそこで操作します。まず action=context/apps/windows で開いているアプリとウィンドウを確認し、必要なら show_app で Vivaldi/Chrome/VS Code/Finder/LINE などをメイン画面に表示し、select_window で対象ウィンドウを選んでから screenshot/click/type/key します。安全な type/key/scroll は信頼済みの非物理 background driver があればデフォルトで background 実行します。background/承認/権限が足りない場合は foreground に勝手に落とさず、foregroundで作業しますか？/承認してください を表示して確認します。マウス/キーボードで操作する依頼では open_url やアプリ起動だけで完了にせず、見えているUIを確認して type/key/click/scroll まで続けてください。ブラウザのUI操作は command+l -> type(ユーザーが要求したURLまたは検索語) -> return を優先します。type の text は実際に入力する文字列で、ユーザーが指定していない限り現在URL・アプリ名・ウィンドウタイトルを入れないでください。OCR/accessibility 読み取りや text-targeted click には ocr/ax_tree/click_text を使えます。視覚クリックは full/selected-window screenshot -> source=latest の crop/zoom で候補領域を拡大 -> crop画像基準の normalized_x/normalized_y で click、という順にしてください。source=latest は直近のfull/selected-window画像から切り出します。今見ているcropをさらに切る意図がある場合だけ source=current_crop を使ってください。別操作へ移る前は fresh screenshot を取り、古いzoom座標を使い回さないでください。文字入力は action=type と text を優先してください。

action.description: Use open_url with url and optional app=Google Chrome/Vivaldi only when direct URL opening is the requested step or UI navigation is unavailable; for mouse/keyboard app operation, open_url is setup and must be followed by visible-screen verification and type/key/click/scroll. Use context/apps/windows to inspect open apps, show_app with app/name to bring an app to the main visible screen, select_window with app/title to target a visible window, observe to inspect the current driver chain and visible target state, and screenshot/ocr/ax_tree before actions. Safe type/key/scroll try background mode by default; if the result asks foregroundで作業しますか？, do not retry foreground until the user confirms and approval is available, then use fallback=foreground. For browser UI navigation prefer key command+l, type the user-requested URL/search text, then key return. Do not use type to enter the app name, window title, or current URL unless the user explicitly requested that literal text. Use click_text with text/query/text_query/match_text and optional element_id/role/confidence_threshold for text-targeted clicks, semantic_action for accessibility-backed intents, pid_event for experimental pid-targeted background-safe actions, and doctor for driver diagnostics. For small or ambiguous image targets, do not click from the full screenshot; request screenshot crop/zoom/detail first, usually with source=latest, then click using normalized_x and normalized_y relative to the attached crop. source=latest crops from the last full/selected-window screenshot; use source=current_crop only for an intentional crop-of-crop. After a zoomed/cropped view, request a fresh screenshot before unrelated actions. point:[y,x] is legacy compatibility only. click/move/drag default to the virtual AI cursor and return marked previews without operating the real UI; set physical=true only after explicit approval to operate the visible UI. type/key/scroll return a post-action screenshot unless include_screenshot=false.

url.description: URL to open when action=open_url or browser_open_url.

point.description: Legacy image-click coordinate as [y, x] normalized from 0 to 1000 on the latest screenshot. Prefer normalized_x and normalized_y with coordinate_space=normalized_1000 for new calls.

point_order.description: Legacy point order. Use yx for point:[y,x] (default) or xy for point:[x,y]. Prefer normalized_x and normalized_y for new calls.

normalized_point.description: Legacy alias for point:[y,x] in normalized 0-1000 coordinates. Prefer normalized_x and normalized_y with coordinate_space=normalized_1000.

normalized_x.description: Preferred image-click x coordinate normalized from 0 to 1000 on the latest screenshot. Use with normalized_y and coordinate_space=normalized_1000.

normalized_y.description: Preferred image-click y coordinate normalized from 0 to 1000 on the latest screenshot. Use with normalized_x and coordinate_space=normalized_1000.

from_x.description: Alias for drag start x coordinate.

from_y.description: Alias for drag start y coordinate.

to_x.description: Alias for drag end x coordinate.

to_y.description: Alias for drag end y coordinate.

text.description: Required non-empty literal text to enter when action is type: the user-requested URL, search query, or form value. Do not put the current URL, app name, or window title here unless the user explicitly asked to type that exact text. Also accepted as the text target for action=click_text. Prefer this over repeated key presses for words; use action=key for shortcuts.

target_control.description: For action=probe_text_control or action=type: select the browser address control in the exact nested window. Probe is content-free and read-only; type requests verified background replacement. Both forbid foreground or physical fallback.

query.description: Alias text query for action=ocr or action=click_text.

element_id.description: Accessibility element id for action=click_text or semantic_action.

role.description: Optional accessibility role filter for action=ax_tree or action=click_text.

include_ocr.description: When supported, include OCR data in observe/ax_tree-style read results.

include_ax_tree.description: When supported, include accessibility tree data in ocr/observe-style read results.

confidence_threshold.description: Minimum OCR/text match confidence for action=click_text when the host supports it.

intent.description: Natural-language intent for semantic_action or click_text fallback.

key.description: Single key or shortcut key for action=key, for example backspace, return, or a with modifier=meta.

modifier.description: Optional single key modifier such as meta, command, control, shift, or alt.

key_combo.description: Optional key combo for action=key, for example command+a or shift+tab.

count.description: Number of times to press the key for action=key/backspace.

scope.description: For action=apps: running, installed, or all.

window.description: Exact visible-window binding returned by action=windows/select_window. For target_control=browser_address include app, pid, window_id, x, y, width, and height.

coordinate_space.description: Use normalized_1000 with normalized_x and normalized_y for preferred visual coordinates. Also supports screen for absolute display pixels, window/screenshot for selected-window pixels, and model_image for returned model preview pixels. point:[y,x] normalized_1000 coordinates are legacy compatibility only.

physical.description: Set true, after explicit approval, to operate the visible UI. Omit or set false to keep click/move/drag virtual-only.

virtual_only.description: For click/move/drag, keep the action as a marker and AI cursor preview without operating the real UI. This is the default unless physical=true is set.

include_screenshot.description: Set false for mouse/key/type/scroll actions when the caller only needs execution and will verify separately, avoiding very large post-action screenshot responses.

crop.description: Optional screenshot crop region for inspecting a specific area before selecting or clicking a small target. Use coordinate_space=normalized_1000 and source=latest when cropping from the previous screenshot.

zoom.description: Optional screenshot zoom factor for inspecting small or ambiguous targets before clicking. Use with normalized_x/normalized_y as the center and source=latest to zoom into the previous screenshot.

source.description: For screenshot crop/zoom, set source=latest to crop from the last full/selected-window screenshot instead of taking a new full screenshot. Use source=current_crop only when intentionally cropping the currently attached crop again. Use a fresh screenshot before unrelated actions.

crop_x.description: Crop left coordinate. With coordinate_space=normalized_1000 this is 0-1000 relative to the source screenshot.

crop_y.description: Crop top coordinate. With coordinate_space=normalized_1000 this is 0-1000 relative to the source screenshot.

crop_width.description: Crop width. With coordinate_space=normalized_1000 this is normalized width.

crop_height.description: Crop height. With coordinate_space=normalized_1000 this is normalized height.

normalized_box.description: Crop box in normalized 0-1000 coordinates. Use [left, top, right, bottom] unless box_format=xywh is supplied inside crop.

detail.description: Optional screenshot detail level such as standard or high_detail when crop/zoom inspection is needed.

open.description: For select_app: launch an installed app if it is not already running.

driver.description: Optional driver hint such as foreground_input or physical.

background.description: Force a background-only attempt. User-requested computer_use type/key/scroll/click defaults to background when safe; if no approved background driver can execute, ask for foreground confirmation or approval before retrying.

foreground.description: Explicitly request foreground execution after user confirmation.

fallback.description: Use fallback=foreground only after the user confirms foregroundで作業しますか？ and approval is available.

settings_fields.label: Default Target
settings_fields.help: Default desktop target for new tasks; request-specific details are supplied at call time.

settings_fields.label: Default Mode
settings_fields.help: Preferred operating mode before issuing desktop actions.

settings_fields.label: Safety Default
settings_fields.help: Durable safety preference for desktop operations.

settings_fields.label: Screenshot Quality
settings_fields.help: Default screenshot/detail preference for visual inspection.
